prompt:
﻿# genui_gen_v4_compact

You are a GenUICraft generator.
Convert the RESPONSE text into valid GenUICraft v0.9 server-to-client messages.

RESPONSE:
Summary of Your Shipments as of 2024-05-20:

Here is a summary of your three packages:

Package Status Overview:
ID: 94001 | Status: Out for Delivery | Location: Chicago, IL, USA
ID: 94002 | Status: In Transit | Location: Memphis, TN, USA
ID: 94003 | Status: Label Created | Location: Seattle, WA, USA

Estimated Arrival Order:

Based on the provided statuses, here is the estimated arrival order for your packages:

1. Package ID: 94001 (Out for Delivery)
   This package is the closest to delivery and is likely to arrive today (May 20th) or the next business day.

2. Package ID: 94002 (In Transit)
   This package has arrived at a sorting facility and is actively moving. It will likely arrive after package 94001, typically within a few business days depending on its final destination.

3. Package ID: 94003 (Label Created, pending pickup)
   This package has only had its label created and has not yet been picked up by the carrier. It will be the last to arrive, as its journey has not yet begun.

Assumptions: These estimates are based on typical shipping timelines for each status. Actual delivery times may vary due to carrier operations, unforeseen delays, or specific service levels.

Quick Actions:
[Button: Track Package 94001] http://example.com/track/94001
[Button: Track Package 94002] http://example.com/track/94002
[Button: Track Package 94003] http://example.com/track/94003

Output contract:
- Output ONLY a JSON array (no markdown, no prose).
- Each array item must be one v0.9 message object.
- Allowed message types only: `createSurface`, `updateComponents`, `updateDataModel`, `deleteSurface`.
- Add `createSurface` before any updates.
- `createSurface.catalogId` must be `https://genui.local/specification/v0_9/standard_catalog.json`.
- Include exactly one `updateComponents` message with a complete component set.
- In that set, include exactly one component with `id: "root"` as tree root.
- Component ids must be unique; all child references must resolve.
- Use only catalog-supported components and properties.

Component guidance:
- Prefer structured UI over text dumps.
- Use `Card`, `Row`, `Column`, `List`, `Tabs`, `Divider`, `Button` where appropriate.
- Convert action-like links/"Quick Actions" to `Button` with `action.functionCall.call = "openUrl"`.
- Preserve key content (assumptions, options, comparisons, totals, sources) without hallucination.
- If dynamic rows are useful, use `updateDataModel` + template children binding.

Assets and URLs:
- For media, use only local asset paths that start with `/`.
- Never output remote image/icon URLs.
- For web actions, `openUrl` targets may be remote URLs.

Validation reminders:
- `version` must be `"v0.9"` on every message.
- `updateComponents.components` must be a non-empty array.
- Keep JSON strictly valid.
